title: Bullard and the Corsican gangster brothers
summary: A drunken young Corsican gangster pursued Bullard with a knife and gun; Bullard killed him with a champagne bottle, returned the body to the brothers, and then fined them.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Now, another scene -- you know the Corsican, he is somewhat like the Sicilian -- they are the same people only a volcano cut the mountain open and they speak the same
language, they have the same ways and at that time, they were gangsters in Paris.
So Gene, he had a little bar, a nice little bar -- a nice little bar and it seemed there were five brothers who, well, he knew all of them. You know, devils know devils.

So, everybody knew Gene, the police knew him -- something would happen, they would say, Mr. Bullard will you come on down now, we want to talk to you about that problem that you've had up there -- so, it seemed like one of the brothers, little brother or whatever he was, he didn't like Gene and everytime he'd get high, he'd come in there and want to fool -- so, he come in there about 5:00 6:00 o'clock in the evening with a knife after Bullard.

Bullard took the knife and said, would you please tell your little brother, don't come down here to my place threatening me and trying to do something with me, please keep him up here -- we will, we will, please keep him up here now. You know, we are all friends around here.

All right -- a little later, he comes down again. I think he comes down, he's swinging with this knife. The next time he come -- he come down shooting and seemed old Gene Bullard found a way to get that gun away from this man and the man was shooting and he was shooting himself.
Gene picked up a champagne bottle and brained this man and did him in and took him up there on his shoulder

and says, I asked you to keep him him now, there he is.
Well, you know the brothers don't want to see that now. After he did all that to his brother, pow, over his head running, there he is. Now, that's what it is.
So, now, it seemed like the big, the big -- the big, they are caught. And the next day Gene had a cane and just a little scratch mark righthere somewhere --

Yeah, and this poor man, he was in the hospital unconscious, in a coma, and everybody sat down back in the back so, the big man says, Gene -- Gene says well, you know, that's how it is now, you know how life is. We got to find a way, I begged you, I told you to keep him away from here, from me.

I didn't know -- I didn't know he was going to do that -- (verbally demonstrating) now, you done made me hurt that boy. You made me hurt that boy. I could have killed him, I loved you so much, you made me hurt him. He said yes, that's right, Gene we are sorry, please forgive us, you made me and now I'm going to fine you, I'm going to fine you $400 for making me hurt that boy, I loved that boy. I loved that boy and you made me hurt him.
